strings.name: Masoud Pezeshkian
strings.summary: Pezeshkian moved from medicine and university administration into politics, serving as health minister and deputy parliamentary speaker. He won the 2024 presidential runoff as an establishment reformist. He criticized hijab-enforcement methods and favored dialogue abroad while accepting the supreme leader’s policies. His presidential authority operates within Iran’s institutional constraints; he continued regional diplomacy in 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Moved from medicine and parliamentary affairs into Iran’s presidency; his reform proposals and foreign policy draw international attention.
